scholarships.title: E-JUST TICAD8 African Scholarships for Science, Technology and Innovation
scholarships.official_source: Egypt-Japan University of Science and Technology (E-JUST)

existing.description: A fully funded master's scholarship offered by the Egypt-Japan University of Science and Technology under the cooperation of the Egyptian government and the Japan International Cooperation Agency, for nationals of African countries other than Egypt. It covers tuition, accommodation, a monthly stipend, medical care and return airfare, and runs for the period needed to complete the M.Sc. degree requirements. Applicants who will return to employment at their home institution are preferred and must have their application endorsed by that institution.
eligibility: Holder of the nationality of a country in Africa except Egypt
Current home address in an African country
Researcher or instructor, or a person expected to become one, needing an M.Sc. in a science or engineering field or other specialisation
Meets all E-JUST admission requirements and passes the academic interview and oral examination
existing.eligibility_summary: Researchers or instructors (or those expected to become such) who need an M.Sc. in science or engineering or another specialisation, who hold the nationality of an African country other than Egypt and whose current home address is in an African country. Applicants must fulfil all E-JUST admission requirements and pass the academic interview and oral examination. Applicants who will continue in their jobs at their home universities or institutions after completing the programme are preferred, and in that case endorsement of the application by the home institution is required.
benefits: Six months of preparatory courses where necessary
coverage: International round-trip airfare from and to the applicant's home country
requirements: Pass the academic interview and oral examination
Equivalency certificate from the Egyptian Supreme Council of Universities and security clearance from the Ministry of Interior, both of which E-JUST applies for on behalf of successful candidates
Endorsement by the home institution where the applicant will return to work there
Full-time study only; scholarship holders may not work elsewhere during the scholarship period
documents: Online international admission application submitted through the E-JUST international admission tab
Academic documents required by E-JUST for the chosen programme
Endorsement of the application form by the home institution, for applicants who will return to it
Two recommendation letters or equivalent, as specified by E-JUST admissions
existing.english_requirement: Full-time students: TOEFL iBT minimum 79 or Academic IELTS minimum 6.5. Provisionally accepted students: Duolingo English Test minimum 125, TOEFL iBT minimum 65 or Academic IELTS minimum 5.5, with a mandatory English language course in the preparatory year. Applicants whose native language is English, from countries where English is an official language, are exempt.
application_method: Submit the online application through the international admission tab on the E-JUST website
Sit the admission interview and oral examination as scheduled by E-JUST
existing.selection_notes: E-JUST states that reasons for disqualification at any stage of selection will not be disclosed and that the schedule is subject to change. Academic background must match the programme's academic background tables. Support is conditional on good standing with the E-JUST graduate programme, and a semi-annual progress report is sent to the sponsor.
existing.best_fit: Academic staff and early-career researchers from African countries other than Egypt who need an M.Sc. in engineering, computer science, basic and applied sciences, international business and humanities, or heritage science, and who intend to return to their home institution.
existing.notes: Full-time award only: E-JUST states scholarship holders must devote themselves fully to study and research and are not allowed to work elsewhere during the scholarship period. Progress is reviewed semi-annually and reported to the sponsor. E-JUST states the scholarship term is the period needed to complete the degree requirements, normally two years for the M.Sc. plus six months of preparatory courses where necessary. The page read documents only the Fall 2026 cycle, whose submission deadline of 15 February 2026 has passed, so the record is treated as a recurring annual award whose next window E-JUST has not yet published.
existing.application_period: Published cycle on the E-JUST site is the Fall 2026 semester, with application submission closing 15 February 2026; the next equivalent cycle has not yet been published as of 2026-10-04.
existing.program_type: Government-funded full scholarship for African nationals, delivered by a national university
